translation.text: Harbour line: track and signal renewal at Castle Street

Line blocked Quayside–Millbrook 00:00 Sat 9 Jan to 23:59 Mon 11 Jan. RRB route 1X, 10 min headway, all stations. Last service before possession 22:10 Fri; first after 05:30 Tue. Journey time +20 min. Renewal of S&C and signalling under Castle Street; enables 6-minute headway from March.

x_peregrine.step_free: Bus 1X is step-free, and so are Quayside, Saltmarket and Millbrook stations.
